QuestInfo.name: Searcing for Remnants of the Dragon Master 1
QuestInfo.0: Search for remnants of Dragon Master Evan
QuestInfo.1: Find a #b#t4032533##k in Maple World and bring it to #bCassandra#k.
QuestInfo.2: You discovered a #b#t4032533##k, a remnant of Dragon Master Evan.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 660\nUnlocks 'Searching for Remnants of the Dragon Master 2' quest\n

0.0: Dragon Master Evan... Exciting, right? Let me give you a mission. Go find the Onyx Dragon Remnants scattered throughout Maple World.

yes.0: What's an Onyx Dragon? You'll slowly find out as you complete your missions. First, find the #b#t4032533##k. Once you complete the mission, you'll receive some really great #bDragon Equipment#k, too.

no.0: It's good chance to receive some great Dragon Equipment, so don't miss out.

1.0: Did you bring the #b#t4032533##k that I asked for?

yes.0: Yes, this is it. This is the horn of an infant Onxy Dragon. This was probably left behind when the Onyx Dragon grew a larger horn. You did a good job. Be sure to talk to me again tomorrow.

item.0: Hmm... You didn't bring back the #b#t4032533##k. Hurry up and go find one!
